Name: Gus Always At Resort
Author: mojomahem
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]This mod forces Gus to be at the Beach Resort so you can access his shop and purchase the recipe for Tropical Curry. When a new day begins, if the Beach Resort is unlocked and the mod is enabled, Gus is warped to the Beach Resort. [/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size][color=#D4D4D8]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098?tab=files][/url]Place the GusAlwaysAtResort folder at C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods[/color]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] 4.5.2
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098?tab=files]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] 1.16.0
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/413150/Stardew_Valley/]Stardew Valley[/url] 1.6.15[/color]

[color=#D4D4D8][youtube]tIvf-e9_Xvk[/youtube][/color]

Manifest.Name: GusAlwaysAtResort
Manifest.Description: Teleports Gus to the Beach Resort and injects his Tropical Curry shop.
